configurationFields.label: Database Name
configurationFields.description: Optionally sets the initial database to connect to when the client run in GSCS is started. The database must exist on the server. Alternatively send the command 'use <database name>' in the GSCS console to switch to a specific database

configurationFields.label: Server Options File Settings
configurationFields.description: Specifies [options file settings](https://mariadb.com/kb/en/configuring-mariadb-with-option-files/) to include in 'my.cnf' for the MariaDB server that are not otherwise set by GSCS. One setting per line, including the option group heading. Additional information on [server variables](https://mariadb.com/kb/en/server-system-variables/)

configurationFields.label: Additional Client Command Line Options
configurationFields.description: Specifies [additional command line options](https://mariadb.com/kb/en/mariadb-command-line-client/) for the MariaDB client run by GSCS (a super user called 'GSCS' on Linux and 'root' on Windows) that are not otherwise set by GSCS. Use with care

configurationFields.label: MariaDB Release Stream
configurationFields.description: Sets the MariaDB release stream from which to install the latest version, unless a specific version is specified under MariaDB Version. WARNING: SWITCHING BETWEEN RELEASE STREAMS OR DOWNGRADING VERSIONS MAY CORRUPT DATA! Update the server after changing this setting

configurationFields.label: MariaDB Version
configurationFields.description: Sets the [MariaDB version](https://mariadb.org/mariadb/all-releases/) to install. Empty = latest version for the release stream specified under MariaDB Release Stream. WARNING: SWITCHING BETWEEN RELEASE STREAMS OR DOWNGRADING VERSIONS MAY CORRUPT DATA! Update the server after changing this setting

deploymentSteps.name: Download MariaDB
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; $MariaDBRelease='{SERVERVERSION}'; $MariaDBVersion='{CUSTOMSERVERVERSION}'; Set-Location -Path 'mariadb'; if (Test-Path 'bin/mariadbd.exe') { $match = & bin/mariadbd.exe -V | Select-String -Pattern 'Ver (\d+\.\d+\.\d+)-MariaDB'; $InstalledVersion = $match.Matches[0].Groups[1].Value } else { $InstalledVersion = '' }; if ( [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($MariaDBVersion) ) { $MariaDBVersion = (Invoke-RestMethod -UseBasicParsing -Uri \"https://downloads.mariadb.org/rest-api/$MariaDBRelease/latest\").releases.PSObject.Properties.Name | Select-Object -First 1 }; if ( $MariaDBVersion -notmatch '^(10|11|12|13)\.\d+\.\d+$' ) { Write-Output 'Invalid MariaDB version format specified'; exit 1 } elseif ( $InstalledVersion -eq $MariaDBVersion ) { Write-Output \"MariaDB v$MariaDBVersion already installed. Skipping\"; exit 0 } else { if ( Test-Path mariadb.zip ) { Remove-Item mariadb.zip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue *> $null }; try { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri http://downloads.mariadb.org/rest-api/$MariaDBVersion/mariadb-$MariaDBVersion-winx64.zip -OutFile mariadb.zip -ErrorAction Stop } catch { Write-Output \"Download failed from the MariaDB CDN. This is a fault with the CDN, not GSCS. Aborting\"; exit 1; }; Expand-Archive -Path \"mariadb.zip\" -DestinationPath \".\" -Force *> $null; if ( Test-Path mariadb.zip ) { Remove-Item mariadb.zip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue *> $null }; if (Test-Path \"mariadb-*\") { if ( Test-Path 'lib/plugin' ) { Move-Item 'lib/plugin' 'plugin-bak' -Force *> $null }; Remove-Item * -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue *> $null; New-Item 'lib' -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null; Move-Item 'plugin-bak' 'lib/plugin' -Force *> $null; $source = Get-ChildItem -Directory -Filter 'mariadb-*' | Select-Object -First 1; if ($source) { robocopy $source.FullName 'mariadb' /E /MOVE /NFL /NDL /NJH /NJS /NP *> $null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -gt 7) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } }; Write-Output \"MariaDB v$MariaDBVersion downloaded\" } }"

deploymentSteps.name: Initialize MariaDB
deploymentSteps.arguments:
-c "cd . && { [[ -f "{SERVER_DIR}/data/mysql/user.frm" ]] || { scripts/mariadb-install-db --no-defaults --port={GAME_PORT} --basedir="{SERVER_DIR}/" --datadir="{SERVER_DIR}/data" >/dev/null && echo -e "
Default database tables created
Super-users GSCS@localhost and root@localhost created with unix socket authentication
Use GSCS's console to manage the server via the GSCS@localhost user
"; }; }"

deploymentSteps.name: Initialize MariaDB
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -Command "Set-Location -Path 'mariadb'; if (Test-Path '{SERVER_DIR}/data/mysql/user.frm') { exit 0 } else { & bin/mariadb-install-db.exe --port={GAME_PORT} --datadir=\"{SERVER_DIR}/data\" 1> $null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Write-Output \"`nDefault database tables created`nSuper-users root@localhost, root@127.0.0.1 and (if applicable) root@::1 created with secure password authentication`nUse GSCS's console to manage the server via the root@localhost user`n\" } }"

deploymentSteps.name: Run MariaDB Server
deploymentSteps.arguments: -c "BindAddress=\"{GAME_BIND}\"; [[ \"$BindAddress\" == '::' ]] && BindAddress='*'; cd . && bin/mariadb-admin --socket=\"{SERVER_DIR}/run/mariadbd/mariadbd.sock\" ping >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0 || bin/mariadbd --defaults-file=\"{SERVER_DIR}/my.cnf\" --port={GAME_PORT} --basedir=\"{SERVER_DIR}/" --datadir=\"{SERVER_DIR}/data\" --pid-file=\"{SERVER_DIR}/run/mariadbd/mariadbd.pid\" --socket=\"{SERVER_DIR}/run/mariadbd/mariadbd.sock\" --bind-address=\"$BindAddress\" --general-log-file=\"{SERVER_DIR}/log/mariadb.log\" --wait-timeout=28800 &"

deploymentSteps.name: Run MariaDB Server
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -Command "$BindAddress = '{GAME_BIND}'; if ($BindAddress -eq '::') { $BindAddress = '*' }; Set-Location -Path 'mariadb'; $env:MYSQL_PWD = \"{ROOTPASSWORD}\"; & bin/mariadb-admin.exe --protocol=pipe --socket={WINDOWSSOCKETNAME} --user=root ping *> $null 2>&1; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { exit 0 } else { & bin/mariadbd.exe --defaults-file=\"{SERVER_DIR}/my.cnf\" --port={GAME_PORT} --basedir=\"{SERVER_DIR}/" --datadir=\"{SERVER_DIR}/data\" --socket={WINDOWSSOCKETNAME} --bind-address=$BindAddress --general-log-file=\"{SERVER_DIR}/log/mariadb.log\" --wait-timeout=28800 --named-pipe --console }"

deploymentSteps.name: Set Up and Upgrade MariaDB
deploymentSteps.arguments: -c "cd . && timeout=60; while ((timeout--)); do bin/mariadb-admin --socket=\"{SERVER_DIR}/run/mariadbd/mariadbd.sock\" ping >/dev/null 2>&1 && break || sleep 1; done; ((timeout<0)) && { echo \"MariaDB server failed to start. Aborting\"; exit 1; }; bin/mariadb --socket=\"{SERVER_DIR}/run/mariadbd/mariadbd.sock\" --user=GSCS -e \"FLUSH PRIVILEGES; ALTER USER 'root'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED VIA unix_socket; ALTER USER 'GSCS'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED VIA unix_socket; DELETE FROM mysql.user WHERE User=''; DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS test; DELETE FROM mysql.db WHERE Db='test' OR Db='test\\_%'; FLUSH PRIVILEGES\"; bin/mariadb-upgrade --port={GAME_PORT} --socket=\"{SERVER_DIR}/run/mariadbd/mariadbd.sock\" --user=GSCS"

deploymentSteps.name: Set Up and Upgrade MariaDB
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -Command "Set-Location -Path 'mariadb'; for ($i=0; $i -lt 60; $i++) { $env:MYSQL_PWD = \"{ROOTPASSWORD}\"; & bin/mariadb-admin.exe --protocol=pipe --socket={WINDOWSSOCKETNAME} --user=root ping *> $null 2>&1; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Remove-Item Env:MYSQL_PWD; & bin/mariadb-admin.exe --protocol=pipe --socket={WINDOWSSOCKETNAME} --user=root ping *> $null 2>&1; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { $hosts = & bin/mariadb.exe --protocol=pipe --socket={WINDOWSSOCKETNAME} --user=root --batch --skip-column-names -e \"SELECT Host FROM mysql.user WHERE User = 'root';\"; foreach ($h in $hosts) { & bin/mariadb.exe --protocol=pipe --socket={WINDOWSSOCKETNAME} --user=root -e \"ALTER USER 'root'@'${h}' IDENTIFIED BY '{ROOTPASSWORD}';\" }; break } }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }; if ($i -eq 60) { Write-Output \"MariaDB server failed to start. Aborting\"; exit 1 } else { Write-Output \"*** NOTE: The log messages above relating to access being denied for the root user can be ignored. ***\"; $env:MYSQL_PWD = \"{ROOTPASSWORD}\"; & bin/mariadb.exe --protocol=pipe --socket={WINDOWSSOCKETNAME} --user=root -e \"FLUSH PRIVILEGES; DELETE FROM mysql.user WHERE User=''; DELETE FROM mysql.user WHERE User='root' AND Host NOT IN ('localhost', '127.0.0.1', '::1'); DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS test; DELETE FROM mysql.db WHERE Db='test' OR Db='test\\_%'; FLUSH PRIVILEGES\"; & bin/mariadb-upgrade.exe --protocol=pipe --socket={WINDOWSSOCKETNAME} --user=root }"
